newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on exports, spread, USDA report.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on exports, spread, USDA report.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on brisk export business, 2,000 Jan-March spreads and in anticipation of the U.S. Department of Agriculture supply/demand report Thursday.

"Cargill sold 2,000 January and bought March. There was big export business. People covered shorts, thinking the USDA's crush and export numbers to be higher," a trader said. Cargill sold Jan-Mar at $0.50 and even money, Mar-May spread at $0.30. January futures crush margin fell to -42.48 from -39.83 Tuesday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 12,300 lots.
Japan bought 15,000-20,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola up $5 to $403.70, March up $4.20 to $403.40
January flax fell $0.30 to $355.50. Jan-Mar flax spread at $2.50, Jan-May $5. Volume was 366 lots.
December feed wheat rose $1.40 to $164, March up $1.20 to $166.70 on late commercial buying, local short covering ahead of the USDA report. Volume was 675 lots.
February western barley rose $1.50 to $139.70, May up $1.50 to $140.20. Feb-May spread at $0.50. Volume was 1,450.
PCTS bought 15 October peas down US$1 at US$186 from Royal Bank of Canada Dominion Securities, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
